arguments.summary: A critical data exfiltration attempt was detected from workstation WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) in the Finance department. The endpoint used DNS tunneling via high-entropy TXT queries to the domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com, resolving to IP 203.0.113.77. Analysis revealed historical Cobalt Strike beaconing from another Finance endpoint (WS-FIN-042) communicating with the same C2 domain, indicating a potential broader compromise. Despite detection, containment actions (firewall block, EPP isolation, IAM disable) were denied due to policy or approval constraints. No malicious payload was confirmed on the immediate source, but lateral movement and prior C2 activity suggest ongoing risk.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious DNS Tunneling via High-Entropy TXT Queries
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
  service: dns
detection:
  selection:
    QueryType: 'TXT'
    QueryName|contains: 'exfil-c2.example.com'
    QueryName|re: '[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}\\.exfil-c2\\.example\\.com'
  condition: selection
level: critical
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate long subdomains (rare)
author: SOC Team
